versions.subject: rule: RUN key pointing to suspicious folders
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 13
    TargetObject: '*\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\\*'
    Details: 
        - '%Public%\\*'
        - 'C:\Users\Public\\*'
        - 'wscript*'
        - 'cscript*'
condition: selection
